newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: VAAL REEFS PLANS ADDITIONAL 25 MINE SHIFTS.
newsitem.headline: VAAL REEFS PLANS ADDITIONAL 25 MINE SHIFTS.

text.p: Vaal Reefs Exploration and Mining Co Ltd said on Thursday that it planned to implement a new working calendar which could add 25 additional shifts to the mine's operational year.

Vaal Reefs' chief operating officer Dick Fisher said that the new calendar should be implemented by the end of the second quarter of 1997, but that it would only win four extra shifts for the mine this financial year.

"It won't be implemented in the March quarter. There need to be certain changes and multi-skilling training. Implementation should be by the end of the second quarter," he said at a results presentation.

The new calendar would be structured in such a way that miners would be able to have their day off on either a Monday or a Friday, with the three days from Tuesday to Thursday operating on a full workforce.
"This (calendar) would give us an additional 25 shifts per annum...We would be working with a full workforce from Tuesday to Thursday," Fisher said.
He added that the new calendar still needed to be discussed at shaft level.
Vaal Reefs produced 16,991 kg of gold in the three months to end-December, compared to 16,968 kg in the preceding quarter.
